notes.title: Game is releasing on october 16th
notes.content:
After 7 long years of dedication, the moment has finally come. When I first started the game, I was just beginning school. Along the way, I’ve met new friends, and experienced countless hours of joy, strife, and pain. And I’ve had a whole lot of fun along the journey. Our unique climate-affectable RPG is nearing completion. It feels surreal that a project this ambitious (sometimes overly so, considering the size of the team) is almost finished. Soon, I will embark on a grander journey into fatherhood and everything that comes with it. I am proud of the boy who started this project, little did he know what was ahead of him (thankfully, in some cases). Below, I will give a brief rundown of what the game is about:

[h1]Unravel the Mystery of the Planet[/h1]

At the heart of it all is your mission to discover why the red goo on the planet is contaminating the groundwater. The question is whether there’s a conspiracy at play, or if everything is as it seems.

[h3]Achievements[/h3]

The game will launch with over 50 achievements, fully tied to your progress in the game.

[h3]Breeding and Mating[/h3]

This features a farm animal named Bill. He has his own wants and needs, and a very distinct personality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624752/51671f6789a296a0b3289f22dc07b9de0419102a.png[/img]

If you do what he wants, like killing David in one of the towns or defeating 7 enemies in the world, he will be very happy and think that you care for him and his needs. If you continue to feed him, he will become even happier over time. He will then help you out in the game world according to his personality. If he’s a healer, he heals, and if he’s a killer, well... he kills.

Farm animals lending you a hand: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624752/9a6bc07c9ba75b8884b6f858fddd4730e66a8594.png[/img]

All animals can be bred to produce better (or worse, unfortunately) offspring if you tire of them.

[h2] Survive the Elements, Affect the Climate, and Avoid Disease[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624752/3eb063d83961e3a0e07e3759a56e85e1b52dd359.png[/img]

Equip the right gear for the right climate. Unfortunately, it can rain, be foggy, hurricane windy, thundery, and even rain acid. Certain gear is better suited to specific climate zones. In the picture below, we compare iron armor to a regular tunic, which is better when it’s hot but lacks stopping power. You can also get sick and have to survive diseases like hallucinations (often seeing enemies and things that aren’t there), fever if you get too hot, cold if you freeze, and stomach bugs. The rate of disease in the world is affected by how you play the game. Everything is interconnected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624752/26fa70bac2937853ca0c7e3facc12d8789cadf4f.png[/img]

[h3]Bosses, Secrets, Lore, and Deep Quests[/h3]

The game is full of bosses and contains tons literally tons of well-designed secrets. These help build the story of the world and can help you find gold and other items to aid your progress. Emotional quests are also part of the experience.

Sinister, huh?
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624752/b5cb2830cb500e444d3d9cb3987d13b0944b0221.png[/img]

Boss fight: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624752/41f3ae9cbdb10946ca9dc0c41e3b4050d4387ad4.png[/img]

Boss fight: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624752/0550cca7ae6beff74c41b0fbbf7dab12760c9053.png[/img]

[h3]Minigames, Working, Living, Farming[/h3]

Live life in a fully simulated world, work, play fully-fledged arcade games, and waste your coins... I know I did.

Working: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624752/893165525b573d3f2c7fd9c502cb729e780e1b68.png[/img]

Slot machines: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624752/4db9b34877de66346e3b5bd613cabdac23922862.png[/img]

Arcade games: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624752/e2191d1fd42c4d0edd2178f43cecdc931c071132.png[/img]

You can also plant bushes that will yield berries to help you.

[h1]Fully Affectable Planet[/h1] Every enemy killed, every life tree planted, and every seed sown plus every quest undertaken will affect how much disease is in the air, how the climate system evolves and ultimately the fate of the planet. This will in turn influence how fast things grow and have a bearing on the survival of the people living on the planet.

Climate affected negatively: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624752/9405f7f1f9162e1c6d6f699e52f41f9868409964.png[/img]

There’s so much more, but it’s simply too much to cover in a single blog post.

Thank you for reading everything. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for supporting the game when it launches.

-Regards-

The Days Of Haze Team

notes.title: DEMO release the first of March!
notes.content:
[h1] Big update!! [/h1]

We will release a meaty DEMO on the first of March. Be ready with the controllers or keyboard or flight stick! Days of Haze is a passion project for us, developed over a period of six years, and now I can finally show you what we have been working on all these years with a first brief introduction to the items and armors.

Let us begin with an explanation of the armor system. In Days of Haze, every part of the world belongs to a climate zone: Hot - very warm, Medium - Temperate, Cold - what it says :-) . Every day has different temperatures and climate and it can improve or get worse by you, which you can check out outside Haze's home:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624752/0343b04c743ffd947aec9f954d1c7a60b66e0fca.png[/img]

Here you see there are 25 degrees in Karma Village which is in the HOT temperate zone. If you were to switch to the nice new beautiful Blue Protector Armor you found shown below. It would have a low hot resistance which means even in only 25 degrees you would overheat after a while and be having to bring enormous amounts of water. When you overheat you can also catch bugs and diseases that affect you in various ways. 

These temperatures in all zones are affectable by how you play. The temperature and amount of wind and rain/thunder in turn depend on how much wildlife you kill and how many seeds you plant or can be connected to quests in the numerous towns. The whole world's climate and people's lives are affected by what you and others do in the world. This in turn affects the growth rate of all things growing, the world is very reactive.

You can also see in the picture below that the armor has a stamina penalty which means you get tired more quickly. The maximum stamina is affected by how much you rest and how well fed you are. So weigh pros and cons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624752/487b36e8733231fa1104e25566bee914d42f9311.png[/img]

Below is a picture of the first inventory page. In the top right corner are quick slots where a lot of items are selectable. You can choose to stack heal items activated by the buttons. Or different kinds of bombs you crafted or special items like hooks and the infamous axe to break rocks and find secrets and new paths in the world. The game is full with secrets and hidden lore begging to be explored.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624752/dcb544f571c7236a22af977e7ae6fcb1ae4dd24f.png[/img]

How do i solve this statue puzzle??
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624752/5839599e2b28e3def884c408b77656d41c59d1ee.png[/img]

The next update will focus more on the Day and Night Cycle, Crafting, and the level-up tree.

And after that we go more into depth of the animal breeding and personality system.

Thank you for reading till the end!! Endless amount of love

Hans-Peter

PS. Here is a bonus picture of the controller layout:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624752/e562e0fcf58eeb6f40004854230f338faee489d4.png[/img]

Game is in development so graphical resources are upgraded constantly and subject to changes.
